displayName: Production database deleted, copied, restored over or its backups deleted

documentation.content: Someone deleted `alyr-db`, cloned it, restored a backup onto it, or deleted one of its backups (log-based metric alyr-db-protected-actions, from Google's audit log). If this was you (a restore rehearsal clones the database; a restore, or clearing old backups, does the rest), ignore it: it closes by itself after a day. If it was not, treat it as a Severity 1: `docs/runbooks/incident-response.md`, sections 5 and 6. Who did it: Logs Explorer, project alyr-prod, `protoPayload.serviceName="sqladmin.googleapis.com"`, field `protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail`. The instance itself has deletion protection on.

conditions.displayName: A protected action on the production database
